versions.content: Cases where the deref function reports an error The deref function shall result in an error if • the first parameter is an empty set • the first parameter is a set with more than 1 elements 18 • the first parameter contains one element which is a value (e.g. 5) • second parameter points to a not existing element in the ECU Configuration Pa- rameter Definition or to the AUTOSAR Schema.
